hero.headline: Your business deserves better than WhatsApp + Excel.
hero.subheadline: We build the digital tools that simplify your operations.
hero.description: Websites, management software, automations and custom solutions for Moroccan businesses.

problem.headline: Your business deserves better than WhatsApp, Excel and paper.
problem.leftText: Today, a booking can start on WhatsApp, be noted in Excel, confirmed by phone and end up on a paper left on a desk.
problem.solution: We centralize everything in a single system.

services.headline: We build what your business actually needs.

featured.title: Management Software
featured.description: Bookings, clients, inventory, vehicles, contracts, payments and operations in one tool.

list.title: Websites & Applications
list.description: Showcase sites, e-commerce, client portals, custom business applications.

list.title: Automation
list.description: Automated workflows, WhatsApp/Email/SMS notifications, tool synchronization.

list.title: CRM & Client Relations
list.description: Sales pipeline, prospect tracking, interaction history, automated follow-ups.

list.title: Digital Marketing & SEO
list.description: Local SEO, Google My Business, targeted campaigns, analytics.

list.title: Hosting & Maintenance
list.description: Morocco/France servers, backups, security updates, responsive technical support.

items.title: Car Rental
items.problem: Scattered bookings, hard to track availability, paper contracts, complex fleet management.
items.solution: Centralized bookings, vehicle scheduling, digital contracts, payments, maintenance, client history.

items.title: Beauty & Aesthetics
items.problem: Appointments by phone/Instagram, paper notebooks, manual reminders, difficult loyalty.
items.solution: Online booking, shared calendar, auto reminders, client files, loyalty programs, integrated POS.

items.title: Medical Practices
items.problem: Overbooked schedule, scattered patient files, slow billing, GDPR compliance.
items.solution: Online appointments, digital medical records, auto billing, reminders, teleconsultation, compliance.

items.title: Training Centers
items.problem: Manual registrations, paper attendance, complex trainer scheduling, slow certificates.
items.solution: Online registrations, room/trainer scheduling, digital attendance, auto certificates, pedagogical tracking.

items.title: Real Estate Agencies
items.problem: Scattered properties, poorly organized visits, paper mandates, non-existent buyer tracking.
items.solution: Property portal, visit scheduling, digital mandates, buyer CRM, e-signature, portal distribution.

items.title: Restaurants
items.problem: Phone-only bookings, poorly optimized tables, paper orders, approximate inventory.
items.solution: Online booking, floor plan, tablet ordering, inventory management, POS, revenue analytics.

items.title: Retail & Shops
items.problem: Unknown inventory, untracked sales, anonymous clients, guesswork restocking.
items.solution: Connected POS, real-time inventory, client files, abandoned cart recovery, multi-location.

items.title: Professional Services
items.problem: Word quotes/invoices, Excel site tracking, confused team scheduling, forgotten follow-ups.
items.solution: Auto quotes/invoices, site planning, team management, client portal, e-signature, cash flow.

flagship.headline: We build real business tools.
flagship.tagline: Management platform for car rental agencies
flagship.description: A complete platform designed to digitalize all operations of a rental agency: from booking to return, including fleet management, billing and maintenance tracking.
benefits: Keep a clear view of activity

beforeAfter.headline: Move from scattered management to a centralized system.

process.headline: From your problem to your solution.

steps.title: Understand
steps.description: We analyze your business, current processes and real problems. No pre-defined solutions.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: We define useful features, technical architecture and adapted user experience.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: We develop, test and document your solution. Fast iterations, clean code, modern standards.

steps.title: Support
steps.description: Launch, team training, responsive support, continuous improvements. The relationship doesn't end at launch.

projects.description: Online booking, POS, loyalty, inventory, team scheduling, auto WhatsApp/SMS reminders.

projects.name: MediCabinet
projects.description: Online appointments, patient records, billing, teleconsultation, compliance, reminders.

whyUs.headline: Technology should adapt to your business. Not the other way around.

points.title: Understand before building
points.description: We take time to analyze how your business actually works before writing the first line of code.

points.title: Build only what is useful
points.description: No unnecessary features. Every screen, button, automation has a precise business purpose.

points.title: Support after launch
points.description: Training, support, fixes, improvements. We stay available as long as the tool serves your business.

points.title: Designed for the Moroccan context
points.description: French, Arabic, WhatsApp, Dirham, local workflows, field realities. Not an imported solution, a solution from here.

testimonials.description: Every project starts with a conversation. Yours could be the next story we tell.

privacy.intro: Last updated: January 2026. NexaTech ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our website.
privacy.controller_text:
NexaTech, Agadir, Souss-Massa, Morocco
Email: nextadigit@gmail.com
Phone: +212 6 79 84 43 25
privacy.data_form_text: When you fill out our contact form, we collect: your name, company, phone, email, industry, main need, estimated budget, and message.
privacy.data_auto_text: During your navigation, we automatically collect: IP address, browser type, operating system, pages visited, visit duration, referrer.
privacy.purpose_1: Respond to your contact and quote requests
privacy.purpose_2: Send you information about our services
privacy.purpose_4: Ensure the security of our website
privacy.legal_basis_text: Processing is based on: your consent (contact form), our legitimate interest (site improvement, security), and legal obligations.
privacy.retention_text: Form data: retained for 3 years after last contact. Navigation data: retained for 13 months maximum. You may request deletion at any time.
privacy.sharing_text: Your data is never sold. It may be shared with: our technical subcontractors (hosting, email) under confidentiality agreements, and authorities when required by law.
privacy.rights_text: In accordance with Moroccan law and GDPR, you have the rights to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port, and object. To exercise them: nextadigit@gmail.com
privacy.cookies_text: Our site uses essential technical cookies and analytics cookies (with your consent). You can manage them via your browser settings.
privacy.security_text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or disclosure.
privacy.modifications_text: This policy may be modified at any time. Changes are effective upon publication. We will notify you of major changes.
privacy.contact_text: For any questions about this policy or your data: nextadigit@gmail.com or +212 6 79 84 43 25.
